This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Asmodee Group|Asmodee's]] [https://store.asmodee.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Asmodee|subdomain=|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://store.asmodee.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} If the URL is a subdomain of asmodee.com, the subdomain can be specified. Default is <code><nowiki>store</nowiki></code> if left blank.
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Asmodee|url=products/star-wars-shatterpoint-today-the-rebellion-dies-squad-pack|text=Star Wars: Shatterpoint - Today the Rebellion Dies Squad Pack|archivedate=20240409145710}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Asmodee|url=products/star-wars-shatterpoint-today-the-rebellion-dies-squad-pack|text=Star Wars: Shatterpoint - Today the Rebellion Dies Squad Pack|archivedate=20240409145710}}
